decisions.reason: As an evolved version of an already well-liked trommel screen with continued dedicated presentation, A appears to meet aspiration levels based on the firm's own past success and should be retained.

The 2019 Stage V update signals continued commitment to the AK shredder line, so despite limited evidence the product likely performs near aspiration and fits the firm's core mobile-machinery business.
C gained stronger standalone presentation after launch, suggesting improving acceptance and results sufficient to justify keeping it while the firm continues learning in a core application area.

Because D was only briefly mentioned at launch and then disappeared from the website, its results likely fell below aspiration and management would reallocate resources rather than carry a weak, uncertain product further.
F remained prominently presented and was described as setting benchmarks, indicating performance above aspiration and a strong fit with the firm's strategic push in stationary recycling solutions.
